title: [Feature/Emulator]: Full 6502 Microprocessor Emulator with Assembler, Flags and Pixel Bus
body:
## Problem
Retro arcade systems and home computers from the 1970s and 1980s were powered by the MOS Technology 6502 microprocessor. ArcadeVerse offers visual tools and games, yet lacks an authentic 6502 CPU simulator with an inline assembly editor and memory-mapped display bus.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Substantial Implementation Scope (Minimum 300+ LOC of core emulation, assembly, and visualization logic):**
   - Create `assets/js/cpu-6502-emulator.js`:
     - Implement full 64KB address space (`Uint8Array(65536)`), registers `A`, `X`, `Y`, Stack Pointer `SP` (`0x0100`–`0x01FF`), Program Counter `PC`, and Processor Status flags (`N`, `V`, `B`, `D`, `I`, `Z`, `C`).
     - Support core 6502 addressing modes (Immediate, Zero Page, Zero Page X/Y, Absolute, Absolute X/Y, Indirect, Indexed Indirect `(d,X)`, Indirect Indexed `(d),Y`, Relative) and instructions (`LDA`, `LDX`, `LDY`, `STA`, `STX`, `STY`, `ADC`, `SBC`, `AND`, `ORA`, `EOR`, `CMP`, `CPX`, `CPY`, `INC`, `DEC`, `INX`, `DEX`, `INY`, `DEY`, `ASL`, `LSR`, `ROL`, `ROR`, `JMP`, `JSR`, `RTS`, `BNE`, `BEQ`, `BCC`, `BCS`, `BMI`, `BPL`, `PHA`, `PLA`, `NOP`, `BRK`).
     - Implement a two-pass mini 6502 Assembler supporting labels, hex literals (`$0200`), and branch offset calculation (`-128..+127`), plus a memory-mapped 32x32 16-color pixel display bus (`$0200`–`$05FF`) and keystroke register (`$00FF`) with 2–3 preloaded demo programs (e.g., color plasma sweep, pixel snake/walker).
   - Create `assets/css/cpu-6502-emulator.css`:
     - Retro hardware workbench styling showing registers, NV-BDIZC flag LEDs, Zero-Page/Stack hex dump inspector, assembly source gutter with active PC line highlight, and Run/Step/Reset/Speed controls.
2. Pure Vanilla JS/HTML5 Canvas/CSS3, zero external emulator libraries or CDNs, zero Unicode emojis.
3. Add standalone unit test `scripts/test-cpu-6502-emulator.js` (`node:test`) covering flag behavior (`Z`, `N`, `C`, `V` overflow on `ADC`/`SBC`), stack `JSR`/`RTS` return integrity, zero-page wraparound addressing, and two-pass label assembly.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Core 6502 instructions, flags, and addressing modes execute accurately with deterministic cycle counts.
- [ ] Built-in two-pass assembler compiles labeled assembly code directly into RAM and runs on the 32x32 pixel display bus.
- [ ] Live debugger displays registers, processor status bits, stack frame, and hex memory monitor during Run/Step execution.
- [ ] Total new code (emulator + assembler + CSS + tests) exceeds 300 meaningful lines across isolated files without modifying protected files.
- [ ] Unit test `scripts/test-cpu-6502-emulator.js` passes 100% under `node`.

title: [Feature/Compiler]: Recursive-Descent Matrix and Math Expression AST Compiler with Visual Evaluator
